title: Zbook
subtitle: Service booking and AI avatar platform
description: A service booking platform for providers, shop owners, and customers, with availability management and AI-powered avatars.
highlights: Built role-based booking and complex provider availability workflows.
Integrated ElevenLabs and D-ID to create AI twins using user-specific voice and imagery.
Added Elasticsearch fuzzy search, Stripe Connect multi-party payments, and Celery background jobs.

title: Capture Pro
subtitle: Photo studio booking
description: A booking management system that helps photo studios manage services and customer bookings.
highlights: Designed secure REST APIs and role-based access for studio service management.
Integrated Stripe and Apple Pay for online payments.
Connected Twilio SMS for booking lifecycle updates and announcements.

title: Real-Time Voice AI Assistant
subtitle: Voice AI backend powering two caller-facing apps
description: A Django backend for an AI assistant that speaks with callers over the phone. Twilio handles calls while Django Channels streams audio to and from OpenAI Realtime. The assistant handles interruptions and searches the web for current information, with concise spoken answers that identify sources when available.
highlights: Streamed live, bidirectional phone audio between Twilio Media Streams and OpenAI Realtime, with interruption-aware call controls.
Added live web search through the OpenAI Responses API for current questions, including news, trends, and exchange rates.
Managed subscription-based caller access, NMI billing and plan changes, usage tracking, subscription history, and per-call summaries.
Added caller-requested follow-up emails with recipient confirmation; Celery and Redis process summaries and email in the background.

title: 3D Printer Management
subtitle: IoT fleet management and live monitoring
description: A fleet management platform for printers, orders, customers, locations, and filament, with role-aware tools and live device status.
highlights: Built a Next.js 14 interface with granular permissions across more than 10 resource types.
Implemented WebSocket camera streaming, temperature charts, and live print-job status tracking.
Created manual and automatic print workflows, priority queues, filament tracking, macros, and actionable notifications.

title: UmeedBazzar
subtitle: Multi-vendor e-commerce
description: A multi-vendor e-commerce platform with secure transaction tracking and role-based access for marketplace users.
highlights: Connected Stripe, PayPal, and Shippo for payment, shipping, webhook, and order workflows.
Built SEO-friendly storefronts with Next.js SSR and live order updates and chat with Django Channels.
Deployed Docker services with Celery and Redis for background processing and availability.

title: KurdFit
subtitle: Multilingual fitness and wellness
description: A bilingual English and Kurdish fitness platform with localized content, RTL/LTR layouts, guided exercise, and personalized plans.
highlights: Built exercise discovery with muscle and equipment filters, video guidance, and health-condition safety flags.
Created custom and expert workout plans, progress tracking, streaks, badges, and analytics.
Added trainer guidance subscriptions with certified coach feedback and tiered Stripe billing with webhook-based access control.

title: Trish App
subtitle: CRM intelligence and automation
description: A CRM intelligence platform that brings customer data together and turns interactions into practical sales insights.
highlights: Ingested and normalized data from Salesforce, HubSpot, and other CRM platforms through secure APIs.
Developed sentiment analysis for customer interactions and lead insights.
Integrated OpenAI recommendations for personalized sales plays and engagement guidance.

title: Drive Talk
subtitle: Real-time social communication
description: An API-first social platform backend with role-based access, real-time communication, and reliable friend management.
highlights: Built real-time chat and live interactions with Django Channels and WebSockets.
Implemented friend requests, accept/reject flows, and blocking with transactional safety.
Optimized PostgreSQL indexes and queries for concurrent workloads.

title: Flow It
subtitle: Competition and activity tracking
description: A competition platform backend for activity challenges, scoring, and live leaderboards.
highlights: Designed the Django backend and APIs for competition participation and activity tracking.
Aggregated steps and calories to power challenge progress and rankings.
Built competition rules, score calculations, and live WebSocket updates.

title: The Showroom
subtitle: Fashion marketplace for Saudi Arabia
description: A Saudi fashion marketplace with dedicated buyer, seller, and admin experiences.
highlights: Integrated Moyassar payments for cards and Apple Pay, including disputed-payment workflows.
Developed Celery-based seller payouts using bank details for accurate settlements.

title: USA ERP System
subtitle: Enterprise resource planning
description: An ERP implementation connecting university departments and improving finance, supply chain, and reporting workflows.
highlights: Led end-to-end implementation and integration across departments, delivering on schedule and budget.
Configured and optimized finance and supply chain modules to improve operational efficiency and data accuracy.
Managed data migration and integrations with other enterprise applications.
